H176.derivation: presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of אַו ; short for H185 (אַוָּה);
H176.strongs_def: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
H176.kjv_def: also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.

H177.derivation: from H176 (אוֹ) and H410 (אֵל); wish of God;

H178.derivation: from the same as H1 (אָב) (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name);
H178.strongs_def: properly, a mumble, i.e. a water skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar)

H180.derivation: or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from H2986 (יָבַל) (in the sense of H2988 (יָבָל));

H181.derivation: from an unused root meaning to rake together;
H181.strongs_def: a poker (for turning or gathering embers)

H182.derivation: or (shortened) אֹדוֹת (only thus in the plural); from the same as H181 (אוּד);

H183.kjv_def: covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after).

H186.derivation: perhaps by permutation for H5813 (עֻזִּי), strong;

H188.derivation: probably from H183 (אָוָה) (in the sense of crying out after);
